sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - AK-105 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I called her Lusya - the neural network, I mean. So, when I keep silent, it does well and even reminds me to get some sleep when necessary, but as soon as I start talking to myself, it attempts to distract me, putting on music or something like that. However, I trained it with movies and phrases from them. Apparently, such a reaction is presented to us in the movies as the most appropriate, but not for me. I'll have to think about what stimuli are the best to mimic real people, rather than society and its stereotypes. But I digress, assemble an AK-105 now, with a silencer and 60-round mag. As for parameters: sighting range over 800, ergonomics above 21, recoil sum less than 500, weight 4.8 kg or less. And compact, as always, 8 slots or so."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 20 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an AK-105 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,400 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 5× Bundle of wires
- 2× Metal spare parts
- Unlocks purchase of Ammunition case at Mechanic LL2
"I think i figured how to train the network! Ah, yes, this AK will do, thank you. Leave it somewhere in the corner, I'll look into it later."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
AK-105 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 500 or less recoil
- 21 or more ergonomics
- 800 or greater sighting range
- 4.8 kg or less in weight
- A silencer
- AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine
Note: Despite the quest specifying a 8 slot build, 10 slots are currently accepted.

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard AK-105 from Prapor LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
